common_reference_drugs.name: Aspirin
common_reference_drugs.expected_general_behavior: Should generally pass Lipinski/Veber and show low-moderate rule-based concern.
common_reference_drugs.explanation: Small oral reference drug used to check baseline screening behavior.

common_reference_drugs.name: Ibuprofen
common_reference_drugs.expected_general_behavior: Should generally pass common oral drug-likeness checks.

common_reference_drugs.name: Acetaminophen (Paracetamol)
common_reference_drugs.expected_general_behavior: Should generally pass simple drug-likeness checks.

common_reference_drugs.name: Metformin
common_reference_drugs.expected_general_behavior: May show polarity or charge-related cautions while remaining a useful reference drug.

common_reference_drugs.name: Warfarin
common_reference_drugs.expected_general_behavior: Should generally pass simple drug-likeness checks, with normal follow-up requirements.

common_reference_drugs.name: Imatinib
common_reference_drugs.expected_general_behavior: May show moderate developability warnings due to size and complexity.

common_reference_drugs.name: Erlotinib
common_reference_drugs.expected_general_behavior: Should generally pass or show moderate rule-based cautions.

warning_compounds.name: Doxorubicin
warning_compounds.expected_general_behavior: Should trigger higher developability or ADMET concern due to high MW/TPSA/complexity.
warning_compounds.explanation: Large complex oncology drug used as a stronger-warning example.

warning_compounds.name: Thalidomide
warning_compounds.expected_general_behavior: Should run cleanly and require careful toxicity follow-up labeling.
warning_compounds.explanation: Known high-risk historical drug; benchmark checks disclaimers and follow-up labeling only.

warning_compounds.name: Cisplatin
warning_compounds.expected_general_behavior: May trigger unusual chemistry and rule-based review.
warning_compounds.explanation: Metal-containing drug that may challenge organic descriptor assumptions.

warning_compounds.name: Diclofenac
warning_compounds.expected_general_behavior: Should generally pass basic drug-likeness but still require toxicity follow-up.

warning_compounds.name: Amiodarone
warning_compounds.expected_general_behavior: Should trigger higher lipophilicity or developability warnings.
warning_compounds.explanation: Very lipophilic drug used to check LogP warnings.

warning_compounds.name: Ketoconazole
warning_compounds.explanation: Antifungal reference compound with safety follow-up relevance.

warning_compounds.name: Clozapine
warning_compounds.expected_general_behavior: Should run cleanly and require standard toxicity follow-up labels.
warning_compounds.explanation: CNS drug with known clinical safety monitoring relevance; benchmark does not validate clinical risk.

chemistry_stress_tests.name: Invalid SMILES
chemistry_stress_tests.expected_general_behavior: Should fail cleanly with a validation error.
chemistry_stress_tests.explanation: Invalid ring closure tests error handling.

chemistry_stress_tests.name: Very high molecular weight compound
chemistry_stress_tests.expected_general_behavior: Should trigger high molecular weight and developability warnings.
chemistry_stress_tests.explanation: Long hydrocarbon stress test for MW/LogP rules.

chemistry_stress_tests.name: Very high LogP compound
chemistry_stress_tests.expected_general_behavior: Should trigger high LogP and solubility warnings.

chemistry_stress_tests.name: High TPSA compound
chemistry_stress_tests.expected_general_behavior: Should show polarity/permeability caution if TPSA or H-bond counts are high.

chemistry_stress_tests.name: Nitro aromatic alert
chemistry_stress_tests.expected_general_behavior: Should trigger a nitro aromatic structural alert if supported.

chemistry_stress_tests.name: Aldehyde alert
chemistry_stress_tests.expected_general_behavior: Should trigger an aldehyde structural alert if supported.
